source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Click tab "Dashboard"
And also enter "Server Health" -> "Sensor Reading"

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Sensor Reading & Threshold is human reable and match with spec.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" sensor get 'STATUS_CRPS1~2' 2>&1; echo ---SDR-FALLBACK---; ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" sdr elist 2>&1 | head -100
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: returns FULL raw `ipmitool (OOB lanplus) sensor get "<SENSOR>"` reading + threshold; user judges (read-only).

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES sends `STATUS_CRPS1~2` as one sensor and therefore cannot prove two independent status records. It supplies no CRPS-to-FRU/feed mapping, PMBus status-word/page provenance, raw bit decoding, latch/freshness behavior or active/standby context.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED correctly calls for two separate reads and vendor PMBus status definitions without fault injection. V3.1 additionally binds each raw word to serial/slot/feed, distinguishes presence, input, output and manufacturer-specific faults, handles composite UI flattening and preserves current redundancy/share state.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 904/2291 accepts a literal range and labels it risk-free without demonstrating two supplies, raw-to-decoded state fidelity, UI freshness, status applicability or protected access.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: Wistron-BMC-00089-V003 is a separate remove/insert status case whose temperature-based Criteria and duplicate AC-drop code remain an unresolved engineering decision; it cannot authorize physical service or define acceptance here. PWR_CRPS1~2 is numeric power coverage, not status equivalence. STATUS_PSU1~6 is the next distinct per-slot family.
historical_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: No sequence-1066, Wistron-BMC-00195-V003 or 673a3c0d6cb60660 draft exists in the invalidated run; the related dynamic CRPS record is a different source identity.
historical_reviews.v3: No V3 record exists for this exact passive row.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-33 preserves STATUS_CRPS1~2; ED-34 treats FRU/status-word/specification inputs as execution readiness; ED-35 prevents removal, feed/load change or fault injection; ED-38 preserves existing logs, forbids retry and leaves formal disposition with engineering.

original_test_intent: Verify `STATUS_CRPS1` and `STATUS_CRPS2` are the two intended CRPS status records, each mapped to the correct physical supply/FRU and AC feed, and that their raw health conditions are decoded and displayed consistently in Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading for the current redundancy state.
original_method: Map CRPS1/2 to serial-bound supplies and the exact PMBus/BMC status sources, read both independently without changing the platform, decode standard and manufacturer-specific bits using the approved firmware reference, and correlate each raw condition with the unchanged UI state and applicable latch/freshness rules.
manual_activity: The PSU/BMC owner maps the two CRPS status sources to physical FRUs and feeds, supplies the approved standard/OEM bit decoder and defines the current redundancy-state acceptance. Automation can collect passive raw and UI data; a human resolves composite or historical faults and owns the verdict. No PSU handling is part of this row.
required_inputs: Chassis/power-backplane PN/revision, BMC build and authoritative CRPS1/2 versus PSU1-6 status architecture
CRPS1/2 slot, FRU PN/serial/model/firmware, AC feed, fitted state and active/standby/hot-spare role
PMBus bus/address/page and STATUS_WORD/STATUS_BYTE/subordinate or OEM register definitions with polarity and scaling where applicable
Stable SDR/API/UI identity and raw-to-decoded state/event mapping, including multiple simultaneous bits
Latch/sticky/clear behavior, BMC polling and UI propagation/freshness rules
Expected normal, absent, unfitted, off, standby, degraded, redundancy-lost, communication-lost and unavailable states
Protected OOB/API/browser client and pinned reviewed `sensor.git` revision/checksum or approved manual method
safety_requirements: Do not clear SEL, PMBus fault history, BMC or PSU logs; latched and historical bits may explain the current display.
Do not issue `sensor get 'STATUS_CRPS1~2'` as a range. Query two exact serial/slot/feed-bound records and retain their full raw status sources.
Do not infer that CRPS1/2 equals physical PSU1/2 or STATUS_PSU1/2; prove the mapping and any aggregation from Project design evidence.
Do not flatten a multi-bit fault word into `OK` merely because the top-level UI is green, and do not require numeric thresholds from a discrete status record.

Do not remove/reseat a supply, switch AC feeds, change load/redundancy/hot-spare mode, reset the PSU/BMC, clear faults, inject errors or update firmware. The dynamic case remains separately unresolved.

Use protected secret-safe access and complete output; do not expose `-P`, assume cipher 17, truncate SDR discovery, run the inaccessible Script or automatically retry after a stale/lost status source.
agent_execution_scope: Validate CRPS1/2 FRU/feed/status-source map, status decoder, current redundancy state, supported protected client and reference revision; build a two-row bit-to-UI expectation matrix.

Read both exact records and underlying supported PMBus/BMC status fields with raw bits/strings, decoded simultaneous conditions, event masks, latch/freshness metadata and timestamps; capture exact unchanged UI rows.
Record PSU presence, role/share, AC-feed health and correlated power/telemetry only as context; compare each raw condition with the applicable Project state and UI representation.
Preserve full raw/redacted evidence without log/fault clear, PSU/feed/load/redundancy/reset/fault/firmware mutation, automatic retry or DUT verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve CRPS1/2-to-FRU/feed/PMBus/SDR/UI mapping and explain its relationship to six per-slot STATUS_PSU records.
Provide standard and OEM raw-bit decoder, composite-state precedence, latch/freshness and state-specific acceptance; approve any Project Override tool.
Review both supplies independently and issue the formal verdict without substituting numeric power, a top-level green icon or unexecuted remove/insert evidence.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Unfit as a complete method because the tilde expression is not an IPMI range and one response cannot prove two mapped supplies or decode underlying status bits. The fallback is truncated, the password is exposed and a fixed cipher is assumed.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Resolve two exact CRPS records from complete FRU/SDR/PMBus inventory, read each through protected access, retain raw standard/OEM status fields and correlate decoded conditions with the exact UI entries and timestamps.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: STATUS_CRPS1~2, both WebUI paths, source readability/specification Criteria, generic clear instruction, Script, DeepSeek command and 1/0-minute estimates remain preserved; Review expands but does not modify Master or trigger a CRPS event.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a two-supply matrix keyed by FRU serial, slot and feed; capture full standard/OEM status words plus SDR/API and UI at aligned times, decode concurrent bits and apply current-role and latch/freshness rules.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The exact CRPS/power-backplane and BMC/PMBus status implementation documented by the Project.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record chassis/backplane, BMC/SDR/WebUI, each CRPS model/firmware, PMBus client and Script revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Project power/slot map, CRPS vendor PMBus Application Note or firmware status specification, BMC SDR/event definition and WebUI state mapping.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Expands the two labels, adds serial/feed/raw-bit provenance and verifies decoded composite state and UI consistency while retaining passive coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A passive snapshot does not validate physical presence transitions, AC loss, redundancy failover, fault assertion/deassertion, latch clearing, recovery or numeric power accuracy.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Two-supply topology, raw status decoder, current-role acceptance, latch/freshness policy and validated collection interface.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: UI health may collapse multiple raw bits; standby supplies can legitimately report different conditions, and sticky history may outlive the initiating event.

project_override_considerations: A Project-approved Redfish/OEM or vendor PMBus interface may replace or corroborate ipmitool only if the original method, reason and engineer approval remain documented and equivalent per-CRPS FRU/feed identity, raw conditions, decoded state, event/latch semantics and freshness are proven. Numeric PWR_CRPS or STATUS_PSU records are not automatically equivalent.
expected_evidence: Chassis/power-backplane/BMC identity and approved CRPS1/2-to-FRU/slot/feed/role map
Per-supply PMBus bus/address/page/register plus stable SDR/API/UI identity and standard/OEM raw-bit decoder revision
Complete raw status word/bytes or strings, simultaneous decoded conditions, event masks, latch/freshness metadata and synchronized timestamps plus redacted Dashboard/Server Health state
Recorded presence, active/standby/hot-spare role, feed/redundancy health and explicit normal/degraded/absent/off/unavailable/stale comparison
Protected tool/Script provenance, preserved SEL/fault history, no-service/no-fault-clear-or-injection/no-retry proof, final PSU/BMC health and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: This passive row consistently asks for CRPS status display/specification validation. It does not contain the physical-removal versus temperature-criteria conflict or duplicate code found in Wistron-BMC-00089-V003; mapping and decoder gaps are provisionable readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The two-supply passive status objective is identifiable. Project FRU mapping and the vendor PMBus/firmware status definition can resolve raw semantics without fault injection, so the case is not permanently BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Changes unsupported YES to PACKAGE and replaces one literal range query with two serial/feed-bound raw-status decodes.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees on hybrid classification and adds standard-versus-OEM source provenance, simultaneous-bit handling, latch/freshness behavior and explicit separation from STATUS_PSU/PWR_CRPS.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Replaces command-presence reasoning with complete per-supply raw/decode/UI/state evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Keeps the unresolved physical-service case and numeric power/per-slot status families separate rather than claiming their coverage here.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: No invalid draft exists for this exact passive source identity.

review_improvement: Prevents a failed range, CRPS/PSU mapping error, flattened composite fault, sticky historical bit or legitimate standby state from being reported as two valid status checks, and prevents passive viewing from initiating PSU service.
independent_technical_reasoning: PSU status is often assembled from PMBus standard and manufacturer-specific bitfields, with multiple simultaneous faults and sticky history. A UI may show only a summarized health value. Each result must therefore be serial/feed-bound and preserve raw bits, decoder revision, role and timestamp; a green summary alone or a numeric power reading cannot establish status correctness.
